chrome.footerTagline: Client-side and private — your results never leave your browser.

landing.subtitle: Take any combination of four well-known personality frameworks — each just a few minutes — and weave the results into one combined profile of who you are.

combined.title: Your Combined Profile
combined.body: {count, plural, =0 {Complete your first assessment to unlock a preview of your combined profile.} =1 {You've completed 1 of 4 — see what we already know about you, and continue toward the full combined profile.} other {You've completed # of 4 assessments. Generate a single, cohesive profile that weaves your results together.}}
combined.cta: {count, plural, =0 {See What We Know So Far} =1 {See What We Know So Far} other {Generate Combined Profile}}

mbti.label: 16 Personalities
mbti.description: A 4-letter typology across how you focus your energy, take in information, make decisions, and structure your life.

bigfive.label: Big Five
bigfive.description: The most research-backed model in personality science — five broad traits scored on a continuous spectrum.

humandesign.label: Human Design
humandesign.description: A simplified self-reflection quiz inspired by Human Design's energy types, decision strategy, and inner authority. No birth date, time, or location needed — just how you actually operate.

colors.label: 4 Color Types
colors.description: A fast, visual read on your dominant behavioral style — driven, analytical, supportive, or expressive.

assessments.meta: {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} · ~3 min

survey.remaining: {remaining, plural, =0 {No questions} one {# question} other {# questions}} left · ~{minutes} min

guidance.body: Answer based on what you naturally do — not what you think you should do, or what you've trained yourself to do. There are no good or bad answers here.

accuracyOffer.title: You've got a usable result already
accuracyOffer.body: Want higher accuracy? {remaining, plural, one {# more question} other {# more questions}} (~{minutes} min) will sharpen the close calls. Or finish now with what you've already answered.

reflection.prompt: Was that hard to answer? Want to leave a quick note?
reflection.placeholder: What made it hard? (kept private, used only to improve the questions)
reflection.sent: Thanks — noted privately, it'll help us improve this question.

skipControl.label: Not sure / doesn't apply — skip this one

middleGroundNote.body: You're close to the middle on {poleA} / {poleB} — this can feel different depending on context.

mbtiResult.footnoteBase: This is a self-report reflection tool inspired by Jungian typology, meant for self-insight and conversation — not a clinical or scientific instrument.
mbtiResult.footnoteSkipped: {count, plural, one { You skipped # question, so those dimensions leaned on a typical average instead.} other { You skipped # questions, so those dimensions leaned on a typical average instead.}}
